notes: Ye offspring is read under rule 89's anarthrous arm, the vocative carrying no article of its own, so the supplied address word is a rule 7 helper on the noun.
τῆς keeps the before its expressed head noun ὀργῆς while the intervening participle μελλούσης takes the postposed to come, which is rule 31's precedes-the-noun clause.
τῶν takes of the under rule 21 with the head on the, the case preposition riding with the determiner.
